sourceFiles.used_for: latitude-band annual means (exported for a future experience; not yet used in sound or visuals)
2x2 degree gridded monthly anomalies (1200 km smoothing)
sourceFiles.history: Created 2026-10-22 14:38:23 by SBBX_to_nc 2.0 - ILAND=1200, IOCEAN=NCDC/ER5, Base: 1951-1980

processing: Global series uses NASA's published annual (J-D) values unchanged.
Grid annual mean = mean of a cell's monthly anomalies when >= 9 of 12 months exist; otherwise the cell is marked missing (never filled with 0).
Spatial variability = cos(latitude)-weighted standard deviation of the annual grid across cells with data.
Coverage = cos(latitude)-weighted fraction of the Earth's surface with data that year.
Grid values rounded to 0.01 K and stored as Int16.
